name: com.devbrackets.android.playlistcore.components.mediasession.DefaultMediaSessionControlsReceiver
description: The PlaylistCore media library receives media-button commands from Android, such as headset or lock-screen controls. It forwards play, pause, next, and previous commands to the app’s playback service.
disableEffect: Headset and lock-screen playback controls will stop working, although the app may still play media on screen.
